cards.title: The player cannot move directly.
cards.description: Movement happens some other way: pushing, pulling, asking.

cards.title: The world changes every minute.
cards.description: Layouts, rules or weather reshuffle on a timer.

cards.title: Enemies help the player.
cards.description: The ones who attack are secretly on your side.

cards.title: Every action has a consequence.
cards.description: Even small choices ripple outward.

cards.title: The player controls the environment instead of a character.
cards.description: You move the world, not the hero.

cards.title: The game reverses its rules halfway through.
cards.description: What helped you now works against you.

cards.title: You play as the monster.
cards.description: The usual villain is the one you steer.

cards.title: The map is a person's memory.
cards.description: Places fade or change as memories do.

cards.title: You can only move when others aren't looking.
cards.description: Eyes are the real enemy.

cards.title: Your tools have limited uses.
cards.description: Every item you use is gone for good.

cards.title: Death is a resource.
cards.description: Dying is something you spend to get ahead.

cards.title: The player is the final boss.
cards.description: Everyone else works together against you.

cards.title: The level is alive.
cards.description: The map itself reacts and moves.

cards.title: Time only moves when you move.
cards.description: Stand still and the world freezes.

cards.title: You share your body with a stranger.
cards.description: Two minds, one set of controls.

cards.title: The UI is part of the world.
cards.description: Menus and meters can be touched, broken or used.

cards.title: Gravity belongs to objects, not the world.
cards.description: Each thing pulls in its own direction.

cards.title: Everything you collect also follows you.
cards.description: Pick things up and they trail behind you.

cards.title: There's no text, only symbols.
cards.description: Understanding is the puzzle.

cards.title: The game remembers across runs.
cards.description: Earlier attempts leave marks on later ones.

cards.title: The player can't see their own character.
cards.description: You steer by sound or by others' reactions.

cards.title: Walls are only suggestions.
cards.description: You can pass through, if you pay the price.

cards.title: Your companion makes the decisions.
cards.description: You guide, but they choose.

cards.title: Light is both weapon and weakness.
cards.description: What saves you also exposes you.

cards.title: You can only carry one thing.
cards.description: Every choice is a trade.

cards.title: Each level is a different genre.
cards.description: The rules keep changing shape.

cards.title: Cause and effect arrive out of order.
cards.description: Results appear before their causes.

cards.title: The world is tiny and you're huge.
cards.description: Move carefully: everything is fragile.

cards.title: You are always being followed.
cards.description: Something dogs your steps, closer each time.

cards.title: Silence is the strongest move.
cards.description: Making noise is the cost of acting.

cards.title: The enemy copies what you do.
cards.description: Everything you try comes right back at you.

cards.title: Anything can be a weapon.
cards.description: Objects have uses you wouldn't expect.

cards.title: Your inventory is a creature.
cards.description: It has moods, hungers and opinions.

cards.title: You can undo anything, but only once.
cards.description: One rewind per level, so choose well.

cards.title: The goal moves as you approach.
cards.description: The finish line keeps shifting.

cards.title: Friendship is the only currency.
cards.description: Everything is bought with trust.

cards.title: Day is a platformer, night is a puzzle.
cards.description: Two halves of one world, played differently.

cards.title: Rules are written on the walls.
cards.description: Read the room to learn what's allowed.

cards.title: You win by losing on purpose.
cards.description: Failure is a strategy.

cards.title: The player writes the level as they play.
cards.description: The path appears behind your pen.

cards.title: Each NPC remembers a different story.
cards.description: The truth is spread across everyone.

cards.title: You shrink every time you succeed.
cards.description: Winning makes your problems bigger.

cards.title: The weather is the enemy.
cards.description: Wind, rain and lightning hunt you.

cards.title: Controls flip each time you die.
cards.description: Left becomes right, and so on.

cards.title: Your shadow plays a different game.
cards.description: It has its own goals.

cards.title: Players take turns being the world.
cards.description: Half play, half make trouble.

cards.title: The map is a deck of cards.
cards.description: Draw and place to make the next room.

cards.title: You are invisible to everyone but one.
cards.description: Only a single character can see you.

cards.title: The final level is the first, again.
cards.description: You return, changed, to where you began.

cards.title: Every enemy is someone you've helped.
cards.description: The ones who come for you owe you.

cards.title: Making something takes away something else.
cards.description: Creation always has a cost.
